data.name: Lian
data.gender_notes: Lian is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Lian was a nymph associated with freedom and grace. In Christianity, Lian can represent the liberation from sin and the grace of God. The name Lian carries the meaning “Liberated, Graceful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lian usually hope their child will grow to embody liberated, graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of liberation from sin and spiritual growth
data.etymology: Lian belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Liberated, Graceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lian total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: ליאן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'lei' (to be lofty) and 'anah' (grace, favor) - God's lofty grace.

in_greek.name: Λιαν
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'lios' (graceful) and 'aner' (man) - graceful man.

in_latin.name: Lianus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'lians' (gracious) - gracious one.

in_english.name: Lian
in_english.long_meaning: From the Old English word 'leohtan' (bright, shining) and 'ian' (Jane, Joan) - bright grace, shining one.

data.cultural_impact: Although the name Lian doesn't have a direct association with Christianity, it has been adopted and transformed to hold cultural significance within Christian communities. The name Lian can symbolize the freedom and grace that comes with faith and the Christian life. It is a reminder of the liberation from sin and the dignity of the human spirit.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Lian holds great spiritual significance in the Christian faith. It is a reminder of the grace and mercy that God extends to us through His Son, Jesus Christ. Lian represents the freedom from the bondage of sin and the invitation to live a life filled with God's love and grace. This name is a constant reminder of the power of God's redemption and the hope for a new beginning.
